command: set -e; gzip -dc /tmp/ispass2027-g1-spi.tar.gz | tar -xf - -C /tmp/ispass2027-g1-spi; insmod /tmp/ispass2027-g1-spi/spi-bitbang.ko; insmod /tmp/ispass2027-g1-spi/spi-xilinx.ko; sd_wait=0; while ! test -b /dev/mmcblk0p1; do sd_wait=$((sd_wait+1)); test "$sd_wait" -lt 30; sleep 1; done; /tmp/ispass2027-new-updater --device /dev/mmcblk0p1 --image /tmp/ispass2027-new-fw.bin; sync
